text: The accepted sync widget builds input.id from the lowercased resource name and punctuation replacement. A calendar and address book with the same name, or two same-named resources, can produce the same ID. Labels wrap the checkbox directly, and capture uses group-scoped inputs and data URLs, so those paths do not require an ID lookup; this does not establish unique DOM IDs. Recommend checking uniqueness if an ID relationship, selector or accessibility reference is added here. This is a scoped static naming concern, not a reproduced label or assistive-technology failure. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Display-name-derived checkbox IDs do not prove uniqueness
